unit: federated-run (stress: rare family never logged at home)
what: One Crosstrainer session, NN_HFL_WITH_DP, 2 clients, 3 iterations. Site A withholds y_mobility and Site B withholds y_congestion from its training labels (RAN_WITHHOLD_LABEL), so each family is only ever labelled at the other site. The scored model is the highest-iteration global model.

target.metric: AUROC of the final global model on the frozen test days for the withheld family at home (Site A: y_mobility, Site B: y_congestion)
target.direction: both at or above 0.90, i.e. a site that never logged a family detects it after federation

also.metric: fraction of true events warned at least 60 minutes ahead for the same two (site, family) pairs, threshold calibrated on the other site's validation days

target.metric: epsilon counting real optimizer steps, per client, delta = n^-2
